page: Microsoft Azure E8as_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Eav6 server family. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The instance features 8 dedicated vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores with multithreading enabled, operating at a clock speed of 3.7 GHz. It is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The CPU cache configuration includes 32 KB of L1d cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong single-core performance, with stress-ng single-core CPU and Geekbench single-core scores placing in the top 25%. Text processing performance is highly competitive, ranking in the top 10% of tested systems. Multi-core performance, memory write bandwidth, and database operations fall within the average range. However, memory read bandwidth for large uncached blocks is relatively weak, and prompt processing for medium-sized 7B language models is also limited.

This server does not include local storage but is Premium Storage capable, allowing connection to external persistent disks. It does not bundle complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Given its high memory density and strong single-core capabilities, the E8as_v6 is suited for memory-intensive workloads such as relational databases, in-memory caching systems like Redis, text processing pipelines, and general-purpose enterprise applications that require a larger memory footprint relative to compute resources.
